---
title: "Practical_1_Introduction_to_R/ukhsa_data_analysis"
---
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
glycopeptides<-read_csv("ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(head(glycopeptides))
```
```{r}
weather <- read_csv("data/weather_data.csv")
ggplot(weather,aes(
  x=observation_time,
  y=temperature_c
)) +
  geom_line(colour="burlywood4") +
  xlab("Date")+
  ylab("Temp(C)")+
  ggtitle("Temperature by Date")
```

```{r}
ggplot(glycopeptides,aes(
  x=date,
  y=metric_value
))+
  geom_line(colour="skyblue")+
  xlab("Date")+
  ylab("No. of Bacteraemia")+
  ggtitle("No. of Bacteraemia tested each month")
```
